en_US.title: Astolfo-bot
en_US.tagline: Modular Event-Driven Discord Bot in Java 17 and JDA 5
en_US.description: Modular Discord bot written in Java 17 using JDA 5. Features dynamic slash command dispatching, asynchronous task execution, and PostgreSQL database managed with Docker Compose.
highlights: CommandHandler dispatcher for dynamic Slash Command registration and routing
PostgreSQL 16 database instance managed with Docker Compose
Environment-variable configuration and structured logging via Logback
